note: This file is a pure MMDetection3D configuration file containing only variable assignments (dicts, lists, scalars). It has no functions, classes, or callable code. It defines training/inference config for an ImVoxelNet 3D object detection model on the ScanNet dataset.
summarize_model_config: summarize the ImVoxelNet model config with ResNet50 backbone and FPN neck for ScanNet 3D detection
review_train_pipeline: review the train pipeline config with 25 image multiview transforms and random shift augmentation
review_test_pipeline: review the test pipeline config with 50 image multiview transforms for ScanNet evaluation
review_data_config: review the data config for ScanNetMultiViewDataset with RepeatDataset 6x oversampling
review_optimizer_config: review the AdamW optimizer config with lr 0.0001 and backbone lr_mult 0.1
